name: Bydgoszcz
discoveryMethod: Separate English and Polish first-party discovery, official municipal custodian review, GUGiK ULDK documentation review, and bounded anonymous point lookup.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery languages found the official City of Bydgoszcz cadastral-material page and GUGiK EGiB/ULDK service documentation. The municipal page identifies city code 0461 and public WMS/WFS access. The national ULDK point lookup returned one parcel and unchanged safe polygon geometry.

attempts.query: Bydgoszcz official cadastral map parcels geoportal API
attempts.outcome: Official municipal and GUGiK sources found.

attempts.query: Bydgoszcz oficjalna mapa katastralna działki ewidencyjne geoportal WFS
attempts.outcome: Official Polish municipal and GUGiK sources found.
Endpoint responded with WFS request-disabled error; this was recorded as a service-route probe and not treated as citywide absence.
Returned service-exception XML stating WMS request is not enabled; no unsafe fields requested.

Returned one parcel: id 046101_1.0128.268/2, parcel 268/2, region 0128, county powiat Bydgoszcz, commune Bydgoszcz (miasto), and a polygon in EPSG:4326. No owner, address, contact, title, tax, valuation, or account fields were requested.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Urząd Miasta Bydgoszczy / local cadastral-material service, evidenced by the official procedure page and city code 0461.
sourceAssessment.publicService: GUGiK ULDK GetParcelByXY, with county EGiB WFS route documented by GUGiK; live ULDK response was obtained.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: id, parcel, region, county, commune, and geom_wkt in the safe response; only native id and polygon were retained.
sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: The returned native id is the sole stable identity. No synthetic or composite identity was constructed.

scopeLimits: The retained feature is a bounded sample, not a citywide completeness claim.
The municipal WFS/WMS route probes returned request-disabled errors; the successful ULDK response is the qualified public route used for the sample.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI would not evidence citywide absence; none was used as such.
Only one unchanged native polygon is retained, with exactly one canonical id property.
Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: Local custody and a live national public parcel response are evidenced. Citywide service coverage, refresh timing, and adapter-level qualification remain outside this bounded research attempt.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP point; exact latitude/longitude retained and transformed only for the documented EPSG:2180 lookup.
